_about: Whitelist of the number guard in scripts/check-facts.mjs: figures that carry a claim marker (%, pp, +, M, K, B, $, BDT, x, "about", "over") but are not claims about CodersTrust's results, reach or finances. One entry per page (or per section prefix ending in /*) and per exact text as printed, each with a one-line reason. Never add a figure that a fact could carry: render it with <Fact>/factPart instead. The check fails on an entry that matches nothing (stale), so keep the list as small as the site needs.
